title: Stealth Usaunny
text: “It looks like an Itsuki or a mushroom designed to grow gigantic… but it still looks like a poisonous mushroom.”
“Do you really love mushrooms, Ju?”
“By the way, mushrooms are nutritious but have almost no calories, so they aren’t really the best food source for survival.”
“Naofumi, you know some weird trivia, don’t you? Did you learn that from a hunter?”
“Nope? I heard it online. So it’s just secondhand knowledge.”
My father is quite knowledgeable, isn’t he? There’s no doubt he could survive anywhere.
“That’s the guy with the bow—he seems to have become a bit more assertive.”
“He’s been through some tough experiences in this country. Could you ask Keel to help him get along with everyone?”
“Got it. If he’s been through a rough time, I’m sure everyone’s been there too, so I think we can talk.”

It seems my father asked Keel to invite Itsuki into the circle of slaves, and they all shared their various experiences together. Due to the effects of the torture he endured, Itsuki seems to have developed a sense of camaraderie with my father-in-law’s slaves.
“So, Itsuki’s going to be staying here too. You know Naofumi’s putting on a circus in this country, right?”
Ren, acting strangely familiar, finally puts his arm around Itsuki’s shoulder as Itsuki steps down from the Rabbit Man.
“Let’s participate in one of the acts together. It’s… just a simple tightrope walk.”
“Ren… you’re something else. That’s not an act you can have Itsuki perform right now… If he messes up, who knows what he might do to the audience.”
“What did you say! Itsuki, stay calm no matter what happens.”
“Ren-san, what are you trying to make me do?!”
Even Itsuki seems to have sensed something ominous, as he’s blatantly resisting.
“Well, I guess I have no choice! Go! Luna! Make Itsuki all fluffy!”
“Yay!”
Luna-chan, following Ren’s command, picks up both Ren and Keel.
“Whoa!? Luna-chan, are you even listening to what Sword-Brother told you?”
“Hey! Not me and Keel! You’re supposed to do that to Itsuki over there! Hey! Luna, listen to meeeee!”
Stomping along, Luna-chan hugs Ren and Keel, rubs her cheek against them, gives them a tight squeeze, and then walks off.
“Where are you taking them?! Hurry up! Hurry up and hug Itsuki!”
Looks like she’s trying to use Itsuki as a human shield.
“Ren… I’m starting to feel kind of sorry for him.”
“What on earth is going on…? It seems he’s being doted on quite a bit.”
“Luna-chan’s favorite Filolials are Ren and Keel…”
“Wasn’t he being hassled by that black kid?”
“Kuro-chan… went off with Rafumi-chan, who’s disguised as Ren. She’s working alongside Ren’s group now.”
Father explained Ren’s current situation to Itsuki.
“I see. It seems Ren has quite the luxurious problem…”
“Don’t you think heroes should all suffer equally?”
“I don’t think that at all.”
At Itsuki’s flat, monotone reply, his Father let out a deep sigh.
“I know I was the one most at fault for denouncing Naofumi-san. I’m not saying this is payback. I just simply envy Ren.”
“I guess it’s just the grass being greener on the other side…”
“I wonder.”
“Hmm…”
Just then, Kou came trotting over.
“Everyone, are you done talking?”
“We’re done. It was a story about a very difficult experience.”
“I see…”
After Yuki-chan, who had been silent until then, explained the situation, Kou came up to Itsuki, lowered his head, and began looking around at Itsuki with a curious expression.
“What’s up? You’re not planning to take an interest in me like Ren-san did and try to kidnap me, are you? I won’t let you.”
To the wary Itsuki, Kou—looking at his tail, which was severed in half, with a pitying gaze—gently placed a wing on his shoulder and asked with concern.
“Are you okay? That tail must have hurt, right?”

Suddenly, I remembered Kou from the loop where my father—who had gone to Siltvelt and dedicated himself to the reconstruction of Shieldfreeden—ended up becoming a sacrifice for my rival, all for my sake. If I recall correctly, in that loop, Kou had grown into a kind-hearted young man who worried about a lost squirrel Beastman and even took it back to its parents. That was all thanks to Elephant, who taught Kou all sorts of compassion. Come to think of it, he’s worried about Itsuki because of the squirrel connection. To think that Kou would worry about Itsuki… Even though there was a loop where he was so fascinated by Itsuki’s shaggy hair that he ended up getting scolded by my Father, the fact that he can now feel compassion for Itsuki shows he’s really grown up. Elephant really is a great Elephant.
“Well, it hurt so bad I thought I was going to die, but it doesn’t really hurt anymore.”
“But it must’ve been tough. You did great despite the pain. Good job!”
Kou stroked Itsuki’s head. Honestly, it’s a completely different reaction from the Kou we saw when they headed to Faubrey.
“Don’t treat me like a kid!”
“Hmm? But Itsuki’s tail…”
Kou seems extremely concerned about Itsuki’s severed tail; he comments on it every time they meet, so Itsuki has started to find him annoying.

“Anyway, since Itsuki’s going to be staying here for a while… he’s a wanted man, so I wonder what to do. If anything happens, it’d be a big help if you could just lay low for a bit. We really do get audited quite often, you know.”

The Three Heroes Church is constantly keeping a watchful eye, coming by to check if there are any human slaves inside the tent. Basically, we ship them out right away, so there aren’t any, though. And as things stand, Itsuki is now a wanted criminal with a wanted poster out for him. Well, since he’s only classified as a squirrel Beastman, I think it’s hard to say for sure.
“It’ll be a big help to have an ally. Depending on the situation, let’s hide out at that ‘safe base’ of Naofumi-san and the others.”

And so, Itsuki, Riska, and Mole became our new members. Riska has been working to fit in with the caravan; she wears a maid’s uniform and takes care of Itsuki’s daily needs. At night, she uses the intelligence she’s gathered to support Itsuki’s missions. About three days passed, and since Itsuki was getting really annoyed by Kou’s constant worrying, I decided to lend a hand myself.

It’s the dead of night, when even the plants are asleep. After confirming that my Father and the others were sound asleep, I made my way to a corner of the caravan’s makeshift tent—specifically, the sleeping area assigned to Itsuki… and slipped right in!

I transformed into my Usaunny form and moved stealthily, making full use of my Cloaking Lance and other abilities. I had to be careful, though, since the slaves took turns patrolling the area as if on guard duty. Along the way…
“Hehe… so cute.”

I witnessed Luna-chan picking up Ren, who was asleep, and carrying him to Keel’s sleeping quarters. It seems he’s been captured and carried off again. His Rival’s parent and Assistant were supposed to be there, but it looks like Luna-chan claimed victory tonight. By the way, since I’d asked Father to turn in early, he’s already resting. I wonder if the Crocodile Man was assisting her tonight.
“Good evening, pyooon!”
And so, we’ve arrived at Itsuki’s bed. Ren’s bed is nearby too, but since Luna-chan took him home, it’s empty now.
“Mm… mm, aah… uu…”
I can hear Itsuki’s strange sleep-talking.
“Excuse me for intruding, despyon.”

I taunt Itsuki in a whisper, “despyon.” I thought I’d play along a bit if he suddenly sat up, but it seems he’s fast asleep. Hehe… If I were to say something like this to my Father from the first world, he’d probably jump right out of bed. Itsuki, aren’t you being a little too careless? Oh? In my head, my Father from the first world just pointed out, “You didn’t say anything, did you? Don’t lie.” That’s true. I said it in a voice so quiet it was practically just lip-syncing. Come on, Itsuki, the Usaunny you’re looking for is right in front of you, Despyon. You’d better wake up soon by sensing my presence, or we’re in trouble, Pyon. He was making weird faces—slobbering all over the place—but Itsuki shows absolutely no sign of waking up.
